name: mal-design-system-monorepo
description: The Mal design system (packages/design-system) and a React Native demo app (apps/mobile).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mal/design-system && npm run export:web -w @mal/mobile && rm -rf packages/design-system/storybook-static/native && cp -R apps/mobile/dist-web packages/design-system/storybook-static/native
